title.value: Learning to repeatedly solve routing problems
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper, which is on developing methods to efficiently resolve routing issues through the application of machine learning techniques, particularly in the context of reoptimization after minor data changes.
title.quote: In this paper, we present a learned heuristic for the reoptimization of a problem after a minor change in its data. We focus on the case of the capacited vehicle routing problem...

extractions.description: This paper explores the integration of machine learning into combinatorial optimization, specifically focusing on the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) where the demand of clients changes but their locations do not. The authors propose a learned heuristic that predicts which parts of a solution are likely to remain unchanged after demand changes, thus speeding up the reoptimization process. By fixing predicted stable edges, the search space is reduced and overall computational efficiency is improved, achieving small optimality gaps.
